Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 141. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 15x
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 100 feet (40 foot radius sphere)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: blast
A ball of energy is created on the user’s finger and
thrown before exploding.
Targets in the technique’s radius must make a
dexterity saving throw taking 5d10 ki damage on a
failure, taking half damage on a success.
You may spend an additional 15 ki upon casting to
add 2d10 ki damage die and increase the sphere radius
by 10 feet.
